card.line: Beth-peor was a city in Moab, east of the Jordan, in Reuben's land, and valleys facing it are where Israel stayed and where Moses was buried.

moments.title: Israel stays in the valley
moments.text: Moses tells how the people stayed in the valley opposite Beth-peor. He was told to encourage Joshua, who would lead them across into the land.

moments.title: Moses teaches the law
moments.text: Moses gave Israel the laws and commands in the valley facing Beth-peor. This was in the land of Sihon, whom Moses and Israel had defeated.

moments.title: Moses is buried
moments.text: After Moses died in Moab, the LORD buried him in a valley facing Beth-peor. No one to this day knows where his grave is.

moments.title: A city for Reuben
moments.text: Beth-peor is listed among the cities of the plateau that once belonged to Sihon king of the Amorites. It became part of the land given to the tribe of Reuben.
